note: The starting kit (#136; docs/11): what a new character is made with, in order (the order is the entries' ids, so it is kept: the world's hash reads it). `worn` goes on the doll, each into its own slot (the sack is the bag on the back); `items` are put where they first fit in the sack, or held when `hold` names a hand; `fill` is a drink's water and `clean` marks that water clean (docs/44: the starting skin is full of clean water). A world may add to it, or start wearing the Developer Bag in place of the sack, when it is made (rules `extraKit`, `devBag`; the Sandbox step). The validator checks each id exists and that the whole fits the starting bag.
